dependency_breaks: Slice at position 7 needs ThreadRuntime, ResourceLedger and Leverage Chain (introduction step 8, S2-16 'now'), but the draft puts the Leverage Chain in 06 (position 8). The slice's win/fail shape is the Leverage Chain, so it cannot be built first.
Slice has no way to talk. Paging (07) is at 10 and the Writing Desk and advisor lace page are in 06. Talk is the main verb, so a slice before 07 tests locomotion and menus only.

Position 3 gives the watch clock but not Committed Time-Spend actions. The slice and presence both need a verb that spends watches. timeHorizonConfig (watchesPerDay, epochWatchBudget) is assigned to 05b-2 at position 12, but the clock cannot be defined without it.

S2-17 rules spine (8 rules, 'now') and S2-13 system graph have no slot in the draft. Every later step is meant to be shaped by them. S2-14 instrument profiles and decay keys (step 7) and S2-15 balancing loops are also unplaced; the draft files S2-14 as 'Delta coupling' in 09, but 06 and the slice use funds.

S2-06 LineBrief and gate and S2-08 authoring kit are 'before-06', but they sit at 11 (08'). The 06 Writing Desk and rival or advisor passages would be written as hand prose, creating the ~15-passage drift S2-04 warns about.
07e is 'reshaped as gates' at 11 but depends on 07d, which sits at 14. S2-10 player-gated world and diffusion split is 'before-06', but closed-form diffusion is bundled into 06a at 9.
05b-2 StorytellerPacingDirector meters thread point-releases, so it needs ThreadRuntime. It correctly follows 06, but the slice at 7 needs release gating, which the draft defers.
split_issues: 05b-1/05b-2 is a good seam (clock and rename versus director, envelopes, storylets, lab) provided PacingProfile.timeHorizonConfig and the Committed Time-Spend actions stay in 05b-1. As drafted, 05b-2 owns the numbers 05b-1 needs.

05b-1 absorbing the presence function (S2-11) is sound, since presence is a function of watch. But presence has three blockers that are not all in 05d/05e; say which. Materialize-on-enter touches the 05c stage swap.

Slice split from 11: cutting 'one thread, few NPCs' out of 11 is clean. But 11 also owns the content-pack plumbing and the authoring kit. The slice should be the first pass at the Epoch 1 pack, not a throwaway; otherwise the data is rebuilt.
Slice includes the end card, but the Legacy Export Gate and epoch-end evaluation are in 09. Use a stub evaluator behind the same interface.
Putting the effect envelope, the Act ring and the BehaviorModule commit together at 4 is one unit and should stay together. Watch the StateSlice clone fix first, as drafted.
too_early: The vertical slice at 7 is built before 07 paging, the Writing Desk and the text path, the very things it must validate under P2 and P4. Its feedback and inference-trail test is therefore weak.

The 05f eval runner at 6 has first cases (evidence coverage) that need Observations (5) and diffusion (not built until 9). It is fine as a runner with a smoke case, but the evidence-coverage case needs a hand-built fixture or comes later.
05a audio at 13 is fine, but nothing depends on it; leave it floating late.
too_late: Rules spine, system graph and Leverage Chain definition (docs and small schema): must be first, before 05d, because they guide all architecture (P1).
S2-14 instrument data profiles and decay keys: should land with the Observation table, because discovery per observer is meaningless with the hard-coded 0.25.
TextSourcePort, LineBrief, gate and the authoring kit: need to precede 06 and be consumed by the slice. Only the runtime SLM tier and timing spike (P2, S2-05) can stay later.
Closed-form diffusion and player-gated world (S2-10): needed by Observations in the slice and by 06 rivals.
ThreadRuntime and ResourceLedger as plain slices (step 8) should arrive before 06, because 06 content registers against them.
